title: Senior QC/R&D
description: Company Description Sika is a speciality chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 102 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector towards greater environmental compatibility. With more than 34,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.76 billion in 2024. Job Description Job Purpose Lead the Quality Control and Research and Development functions to ensure consistent product quality, develop and improve construction chemical formulations, and support efficient manufacturing. Drive innovation, cost optimization, and technical problem-solving while ensuring that products meet approved specifications, customer requirements, applicable standards, and Sika’s technical and safety requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. Quality Control and Product Conformity Manage the inspection and testing of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediate products, and finished goods against approved specifications. Establish and maintain sampling plans, testing methods, acceptance criteria, and traceable quality records. Oversee material and finished-product release decisions within delegated authority, ensuring that nonconforming materials are identified, segregated, and controlled. Investigate quality deviations, batch failures, and recurring defects with Production and other relevant functions; verify the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions. Monitor quality trends and recommend improvements to product consistency, testing reliability, and manufacturing processes. 2. Research and Product Development Lead the development, localization, and improvement of construction chemical products within the assigned portfolio. Translate market needs and customer requirements into defined development projects with Sales, Marketing, and Technical teams. Plan laboratory experiments, performance evaluations, application trials, and stability studies to validate new and modified formulations. Coordinate with Sika’s regional and global R&D teams on technology transfer, technical approvals, and knowledge sharing. Maintain a prioritized development pipeline with clear objectives, responsibilities, milestones, and progress reporting. 3. Raw Materials and Formulation Optimization Evaluate alternative raw materials and suppliers with Procurement to improve supply continuity, product performance, and cost efficiency. Lead formulation optimization initiatives while maintaining required quality, safety, application performance, and shelf life. Ensure that material substitutions and formulation changes are tested, documented, and approved before implementation. Support initiatives to reduce waste and environmental impact, with appropriate technical validation of resulting product claims. 4. Production Support and Industrialization Lead the technical transfer of approved formulations from laboratory trials to pilot and commercial production. Establish manufacturing instructions, process parameters, and quality checkpoints with Production. Support troubleshooting of processing difficulties and product performance issues, identifying sustainable technical solutions. Work with Technical Service and Sales to investigate customer complaints, conduct relevant testing, and recommend corrective actions. Provide technical training on product characteristics, testing requirements, and manufacturing controls. 5. Laboratory Management and Safety Manage laboratory capacity, workloads, equipment, consumables, and testing priorities to support production and development requirements. Ensure that instruments are calibrated, maintained, and suitable for their intended tests. Maintain effective sample identification, retention, storage, and disposal arrangements. Ensure safe laboratory practices, chemical handling, housekeeping, and waste management in coordination with EHS. Maintain reliable and complete experimental records and test results. 6. Quality Systems and Technical Documentation Maintain controlled formulations, specifications, test methods, manufacturing instructions, and technical records. Ensure that approved formulation changes are accurately reflected in bills of materials and relevant systems. Support ISO 9001 requirements and applicable internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits. Coordinate product testing and certification against applicable Egyptian and international standards. Support accurate product data, safety documentation, and labelling with the responsible functions. Protect confidential formulations, technical information, and intellectual property. 7. People Leadership and Department Management Set objectives, allocate responsibilities, and monitor the performance of QC and R&D employees. Coach and develop the team, assess technical competencies, and maintain training and succession plans. Prepare and control departmental budgets, including testing expenses, equipment requirements, and development resources. Report quality performance, development progress, savings, resource needs, and significant technical risks to management. Maintain effective coordination with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, EHS, Finance, and HR. Qualifications Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Suggested experience: at least eight years in construction chemicals or a closely related manufacturing sector, including three years in a managerial or supervisory role. Demonstrated experience in both formulation development and quality control. Strong knowledge of relevant product technologies, laboratory testing, industrial scale-up, and root-cause analysis. Working knowledge of ISO 9001, applicable product standards, and laboratory safety. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant ERP or laboratory systems; SAP experience is an advantage. Strong communication skills in English and Arabic. Additional Information We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

title: Principal Product Manager
description: Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns About us: As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Guest Experience organization. Target is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target. The Post Purchase & Returns Product team is responsible for creating seamless, reliable, and differentiated guest experiences after an order is placed. The team builds capabilities across order tracking, fulfillment, order modifications, payments, returns, and refunds, enabling greater transparency, convenience, and control for guests. Through platform modernization, intelligent automation, and innovative digital experiences, we strive to simplify complex post-purchase journeys, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen guest trust and loyalty. About the role: This Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns role will be based in Target in India (TII) and will serve as a senior individual contributor, driving product strategy and execution for critical capabilities within Target's post-purchase ecosystem in close partnership with leaders and teams across Target. As Principal Product Manager, you will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for complex post-purchase capabilities, translating guest needs, business priorities, and technology opportunities into scalable solutions. You will drive meaningful improvements in guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes while ensuring products meet enterprise standards for reliability, usability, and scalability. You will lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple business and technology teams, partnering with senior leaders across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, and Guest Services to align priorities, navigate trade-offs, and remove execution barriers. You will influence decisions across interconnected products and platforms, balancing long-term strategic investments with near-term business needs. You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, leveraging guest insights, analytics, experimentation, and competitive intelligence to validate opportunities and inform product decisions. You will establish clear goals and OKRs, assess product health and financial impact, and use data-driven insights to prioritize investments and deliver measurable outcomes. You will partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to modernize foundational platforms, improve system reliability, and identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to simplify post-purchase experiences and operations. As a senior individual contributor, you will serve as a product thought leader, influencing product direction across teams, mentoring product managers, and elevating product management practices through expertise, collaboration, and strategic influence rather than direct people management. Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs. About you: Four-year degree or equivalent experience. 7+ years of product management experience, including experience leading complex, enterprise-scale digital products. Proven experience defining product strategy and roadmaps and driving measurable business outcomes across complex product ecosystems. Strong understanding of e-commerce, retail, order management, fulfillment, or post-purchase experiences, including order tracking, modifications, cancellations, returns, and refunds. Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple business and technology teams, navigating ambiguity and competing priorities. Experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to build scalable, reliable platforms and modernize legacy technology ecosystems. Strong business acumen with the ability to evaluate guest experience, operational efficiency, financial impact, and return on investment to inform product decisions. Expertise in product discovery, experimentation, analytics, and data-driven decision-making, with a strong ability to define OKRs and measure product success. Strong communication and executive presence, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and driving alignment across large enterprise organizations. Expertise in agile product development, including iterative delivery, prioritization, user stories, and working with cross-functional scrum teams. Strategic mindset and bias for action, with the ability to balance long-term product vision with near-term execution and business priorities. Ability to identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including AI and automation, to improve guest experiences and operational efficiency. Demonstrated ability to mentor product managers, elevate product thinking, and drive strategic influence without formal people management authority. Strong ability to build relationships and collaborate across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Guest Services, and Target in India. title: Market Intelligence Analyst
description: About Signant Health At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. About the Role The Market Intelligence Analyst a key member of our fast-growing Corporate Marketing team and will work closely with third party databases along with marketing, sales and product teams to gain in-depth intelligence and insights into our customers’ planned trials, competitors, and key target markets. The Market Intelligence Analyst is a results-oriented, analytical and methodical research leader who finds and interprets market, sales and competitive information to deliver the insights Signant Health needs to sustain and enable growth. This person will improve the focus and precision of our indication-specific, go to market strategies and plans while improving our competitive position and accelerating our target market penetration. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function 1. Provide regular ongoing analysis of the full clinical trial landscape using third party databases and company research; provide these analyses to inform marketing and sales focus at the indication and company level. 2. Develop deep dives and profiles on specific companies and compounds to help sales understand customer dynamics and identify opportunities to target. 3. Present research findings to sales team and other senior internal stakeholders. 4. Build and maintain a strong understanding of competitors and distill findings to marketing, sales and product. 5. Review investor presentations and meetings, and produce write-ups that distill key information for senior teams. 6. Work closely with sales in win/loss analysis and to understand regional differences in the competitive landscape. 7. Remain fully informed on analyst research and industry thought leaders. Present findings back to product marketing, sales and leadership team. 8. Working on adhoc strategic projects, including but not limited to assisting with the team with research, customer/marketplace diligence, and meeting coordination. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES Essential: 1. 2 + years of demonstrated experience with both qualitative and quantitative market research skills, including but not limited to data analysis, competitive intelligence, data synthesis, SWOT analysis, and data driven recommendations. 2. 1 + years of experience working with clinical trial research tools; experience with GlobalData or TrialTrove a big plus. 3. Strong understanding of the drug-development and clinical-trials landscape. 4. Demonstrable ability to analyse company financial performance, clinical pipelines, competitor activity and wider market trends. 5. Strong quantitative skills and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables and analysis of large datasets. 6. Excellent written communication and the ability to distil complex research, earnings information and datasets into concise commercial insights. 7. Strong analytical judgement and the ability to draw conclusions from multiple quantitative and qualitative sources. 8. Ability to manage concurrent weekly, monthly, quarterly and ad-hoc deliverables while meeting time-sensitive deadlines. 9. High attention to detail and a rigorous approach to data quality and source validation. 10. Confidence working independently and engaging with senior commercial stakeholders. 11. Bachelor’s degree required. 12. Working knowledge of Microsoft Powerpoint. Desirable: 1. Experience analysing pharmaceutical clinical pipelines, therapeutic areas and probability/likelihood of approval. 2. Experience monitoring biotech funding, venture capital, IPOs, private placements and M&A activity. 3. Knowledge of the CRO market and competitive landscape. 4. Experience using FactSet, Salesforce and/or Power BI. 5. Experience analysing quarterly earnings, investor presentations and earnings-call transcripts. 6. Experience with Claude, Microsoft Copilot or similar generative-AI platforms for structured research and analysis. #LI-AB1 Why Signant Health? At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo. If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it. title: Product Owner
description: Data Governance and Data Hygiene Product Owner One role · Contract-to-hire · India Role summary You will own the data hygiene program day to day. You will turn a backlog of more than 40 known data problems into defined, prioritized, and verified cleanup work. Over time, you will build that into a lasting data governance practice. You work directly with business leaders and operations teams, so clear communication and a real understanding of how the business runs matter as much as technical skill. What you will do Own and prioritize the data hygiene backlog, sequenced against the 2027 roadmap releases. Meet with business owners and operations leads to understand their processes, why the data breaks, and what clean data has to look like for them. Write clear business definitions and a business glossary for each data domain, in plain language business users can sign off on. Define critical fields, data quality rules, and how quality is measured for each domain. Plan bulk cleanups: what to fix, how (mass update, matching algorithm, or reload), how to validate it, and who signs off. Lead the two Data Quality Analysts: assign work, review their output, and remove blockers. Keep a gap log of each data issue found, who owns the fix, and when it closed. Work with the data platform and Salesforce teams on field and model changes, and with the data team on automated quality checks. Report progress to U.S. leadership in short, clear updates: what was cleaned, what changed in the numbers, and what is next. Over time, set up change control for new fields and definitions with business owners. What we are looking for Critical (must have) Communication. You explain data problems and trade-offs clearly to nontechnical business leaders, in writing and live. You run a meeting, push back politely, and follow up. Business understanding. You learn how an operations business works (how work moves from sale to field to invoice) and connect each data problem to its business impact. Technical skill. You write and read SQL well enough to profile data, check a cleanup, and challenge an analyst's work. Snowflake experience is preferred. Also required 5+ years in data governance, data quality, master data management, or a data product owner or business analyst role. Experience owning a backlog and prioritizing with business stakeholders. Experience writing data definitions, glossaries, or data quality rules. Comfortable working with U.S. teams until at least 12:00 p.m. Pacific. Nice to have Field service, facilities, utilities, telecom, or energy industry experience. Salesforce data model experience (Service Cloud or Field Service). Experience with data catalog or governance tools. Power BI or another BI tool. Agile and Azure DevOps. What success looks like in the first 90 days Glossaries and quality baselines in place for the asset and technician domains. The first bulk cleanups delivered and signed off by their business owners. A working weekly rhythm with business owners and the analysts, with a backlog leadership can see.

Plan bulk cleanups: what to fix, how (mass update, matching algorithm, or reload), how to validate it, and who signs off. Over time, set up change control for new fields and definitions with business owners. What we are looking for Critical (must have) Communication. You explain data problems and trade-offs clearly to nontechnical business leaders, in writing and live. You run a meeting, push back politely, and follow up. Business understanding. You learn how an operations business works (how work moves from sale to field to invoice) and connect each data problem to its business impact. Technical skill. Experience owning a backlog and prioritizing with business stakeholders. Experience writing data definitions, glossaries, or data quality rules. Salesforce data model experience (Service Cloud or Field Service). Experience with data catalog or governance tools. Power BI or another BI tool. Agile and Azure DevOps.
